title: Human support handoff
content: For requests that require staff confirmation, ask the customer to contact Belikeme Support.

title: Return policy requires staff confirmation
content: Return and refund requests require staff confirmation. Do not promise eligibility, refunds, or timelines.

title: Shipping questions require staff confirmation
content: Shipping and delivery questions that require confirmation should be handed off to staff.

title: Sizing questions require staff confirmation
content: Sizing advice can be general only. If the customer needs exact measurements, hand off to staff.
